reviewer_statement: A provisional developer-reviewed native R scientific plotting contract on a genuine simulated functional result. Numeric source artists have pinned Python 1.2 comparisons in committed tests, but successful exact-head CI has not yet been observed, and native R cannot return Matplotlib Axes or provide runtime class parity. This is not independent full-domain certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R scientific geometry is source-aligned on accepted simulated truth and original observations. Source plot semantics for numeric zero-based indices, finite scatter masks, phase-warp line order and population variance are implemented in strict mode. Python plotting Axes identity, Matplotlib rendering bytes and exception classes are excluded.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_functional_simulation_score_variances. Six grouped source score-variance artist families across curve, participant, trial sources and declared/realized values.

Native genuine functional simulation with complete finite curve/participant/trial score matrices and corresponding component eigenvalues. Strict scientific mode requires valid native result class and all six source bar arrays. No alternative statistical variance estimator is used; matplotlib axes injection and native Python bar artists are unsupported.

Source declared columns are curve eigenvalues, participant eigenvalues, trial eigenvalues; realized columns compute NumPy population var(ddof=0), exactly mean((scores-mean)^2) rather than sample n-1 variance. Six bar families ordered per source declared then realized and arranged with Matplotlib width .18 and x-center offsets source-2.5 and source+.5. Frozen public Matplotlib bar patches get_x()+width/2, get_height, width and legend labels are compared on same native actual simulation truth in committed direct source tests.

Reject malformed simulation truth scores or source component counts, nonfinite/negative source variances, unsupported class and nonlogical strict flag. Matplotlib backend exceptions and runtime object identity are not copied.

Source Matplotlib Axes has six bar containers with source axis title/ticks and legend. Native R strict artist record preserves every source bar center, height, width and label, semantic tick text and exact source legend order. Native base R remains a distinct pixel and class backend.

Descriptive audit of declared versus population-realized variance in simulated curve-level, participant-level and trial-level FPC score sources, with correct NumPy ddof=0 denominator and no sampling-variance bias correction.

independent_review_status: Provisional scoped native scientific geometry author review; exact-head differential CI queued/unverified, independent certification zero.
language_specific_limits: R base plotting does not implement Python Matplotlib Axes or Figure return type, external ax parameter or pixel-equivalent rendering.
Strict result is a genuine native R simulated object with source artist data, not a Python FunctionalSimulationResult dataclass instance.
Python and R exceptions, plot legend backend state and Matplotlib figure event machinery remain different.
New tests have not been observed executing green, and no independent source-contract approval, main-branch merge or CRAN qualification is claimed.
